description: Delete fblocks in the range. Warning: rejected by live 3DEC 9.7.47 ('fblock' enumerates only 'list'; 'fblock delete' fails at parse level) although the official 9.7 HTML page documents it. fblock group is also accepted by the engine despite not being enumerated. Treat fblock delete as unavailable in 3DEC 9.7.
notes: The manual documents this command, but 3DEC 9.8 and 7.00 reject it: 'fblock ?' offers only list.
